credits.title: Haiku
credits.overview: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

credits.title: Baththa
credits.overview: In 1986 Madras, a timid eight-year-old boy accidentally traps a feared gangster inside a deserted school toilet. As the gangster is forced to confront hunger, loneliness and his own vulnerability, an unlikely bond begins to grow between the two.

credits.title: Vadam
credits.overview: A action packed Village Family Drama. Hero’s Extraordinary Bond with his Bull. Story based on “Vada Manju Virattu”.  Family relationship highlighted emotionally

credits.title: Pookie
credits.overview: He struggles to tell her he wants to separate. When he finally does, she shares the same thoughts. Suddenly realizing he doesn't want to lose her, they reconcile though both still privately consider breaking up.

credits.title: Lockdown
credits.overview: During a national emergency, Anita finds herself isolated at home while facing personal challenges. As she adapts to the new reality, an unexpected situation tests her resilience and changes her perspective on life.

credits.title: Kombuseevi
credits.overview: Having a miserable past of being evacuated from their homeland and losing their livelihood, Rokkapuli and Pandi are among the main people of the village who aspire to become millionaires by peddling ganja (marijuana). Can they successfully achieve their dream?

credits.title: Idli Kadai
credits.overview: A simple man's search for success leads him to rediscover his roots.

credits.title: Dheeran
credits.overview: When news of Eldhose's death, a man once adored by the locals, reaches his village, his uncles embark on a chaotic trip in an ambulance to bring his body back home.

credits.title: Dragon
credits.overview: Raghavan transforms from a school topper into a “bad boy” to score girls in college, but ends up a heartbroken dropout. He then cons his way into a successful finance career, but the lies keep building and maintaining the facade proves tricky.

credits.title: Siren
credits.overview: After being in jail for 14 years, Thilagavarman gets out of prison on parole. A cat-and-mouse chase unfolds as Nandhini, a tainted police officer zeroes in on him as suspect in a spate of murders

credits.title: Lal Salaam
credits.overview: When a cricket game between two brothers goes wrong, a group of Indian villages are torn apart in the process. With tensions exacerbated by a scheming politician, the two brothers and their father must reconcile their differences to revitalize the locals’ Hindu and Muslim unity.

credits.title: Katharbasha Endra Muthuramalingam
credits.overview: An arrogant yet righteous man decides to get married to a woman, who has been suffering at the hands of her relatives. Little does he realize that an enmity from his past is going to invite trouble in his personal life.

credits.title: Theerkadarishi
credits.overview: A stranger keeps calling the police control room to hint about various crimes and accidents that are about to occur in the near future. Can the police department stop an accident based on his information and also find out who their mysterious informer actually is?

credits.title: Agent Kannayiram
credits.overview: A struggling private detective is drawn towards a mystery around unidentified dead bodies turning up near railway tracks, and soon the case becomes significant both at the professional and personal levels.

credits.title: Viruman
credits.overview: An intrepid and good-hearted son fights to make his arrogant father pay the price for his sins, which includes his mother's death, and save his brothers from the man's grip.

credits.title: Vattam
credits.overview: A tormented Mano decides to solve his problems after his break-up. But things get worse when he finds himself caught between kidnappers and a distressed couple.

credits.title: Anbulla Ghilli
credits.overview: Ghilli, a dog, navigates through several challenges and experiences with his owner as both of them attempt to win the hearts of their lovers.

credits.title: Kasada Thapara
credits.overview: The lives of a few individuals get impacted, both in good and bad ways, by the actions of others who are hardly connected to them.

credits.title: Magamuni
credits.overview: Two long-separated brothers end up in life-threatening situations. How do their lives intersect and what happens next?

credits.title: Kadaikutty Singam
credits.overview: Gunasingam, a family-loving farmer who hails from a small town, tries his best to keep his big family united despite him being misunderstood by many.
